mapper.select: SELECT c.product_id AS productId, c.member_id AS memberId, c.quantity AS quantity, p.name AS productName, p.price AS price, p.image_url AS imageUrl FROM cart c JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (product_id, member_id, quantity, product_name, price, image_url) VALUES (#{productId}, #{memberId}, #{quantity}, #{productName}, #{price}, #{imageUrl})
